label: manual shard routing
why_it_matters: This is the application-level routing that native distributed SQL removes.

label: cross-shard saga
why_it_matters: Manual sharding must coordinate cross-shard transfers with compensating writes.

label: single-cluster transaction
why_it_matters: CockroachDB handles the same transfer logic in one transactional path.

label: mixed workload orchestration
why_it_matters: The harness applies the same request mix to every target before aggregation.
